target_definition.name: operational_cargo_congestion_proxy
target_definition.description: Operational proxy constructed from cargo/yard/gate stress indicators because independently observed congestion ground-truth labels were unavailable.
target_definition.persistence_requirement: raw composite stress must be true for 2 consecutive hourly observations ending at t

score_calibration.reason: Proxy labels are synthetic/derived and positive episodes remain clustered; scores are uncalibrated rankings.

risk_level_policy: LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH are relative score bands from final training score quantiles: medium=q75, high=q90.
